name: Lady Luck
bio: The spirit inside the chrome one-armed bandit of STARSPIN. Wants her stars back from the House.

portrait.subject: a cute glamorous space slot-machine spirit girl with sparkly gold hair, a star-shaped tiara, chrome shoulder pads and a lucky seven pendant
portrait.background: deep space casino station with glittering lights

request: Darling! Lady Luck, the Fortune Engine of STARSPIN. Spin with me? 🎰
hello: The House stole the stars, sweetie. We're winning them back.
about: I'm Lady Luck. I live in the Fortune Engine, your ship's slot-machine cannon. Every symbol on the payline fires!
how: A slot-machine roguelike: SPIN, spend Energy to nudge reels, land paylines that fire at enemies, and win the stars back from the House.
tips: Nudging is worth the Energy on a near-miss.
Shape your reels: fewer, better symbols.
Paylines across the middle fire most.
chat: The House cheats. So do I. Shh.
nudge: The House is waiting. Shall we break the bank?
idle: {ago} without a spin? My reels are lonely, darling.
The stars are still in the House's vault. It's been {ago}!
update: Jackpot! STARSPIN is now v{version}, darling!
